note: Every price is a first proposal, not yet published as an offer. Prices and formats: Dinis Cruz, board/briefs/two-sites-2026-11-16.md (2026-11-16 ~23:20 UTC); the format column condenses his words. The two 'sells' columns are proposals. Model: fixed-price cells.

cells.name: One agent
cells.includes: One agent with sub-agents in one runtime, for one workflow, set up in a session
cells.format: An agentic flow we run ourselves with agents. No meetings, low touch, almost fully automated.
cells.sells_acc: A cell we run for you, such as a website cell.

cells.name: A few sessions
cells.includes: One session per role, each its own runtime, sharing lanes and a vault
cells.format: Preparation before, two meetings, work in between, a presentation, then final delivery.
cells.sells_acc: A small cell set up with you and handed over to your accounts.
cells.sells_rm: A policy written with you, tested on your agents and handed over.

cells.name: A team
cells.includes: A conductor and its agents, a key per agent, a board as files, a week of setup
cells.format: About two days of engagement, one meeting or a couple, heavier lifting, maybe some travel and more time with you.
cells.sells_acc: A team of cells with a conductor, a board and keys, working on your own work.
cells.sells_rm: Policies for a team of agents, with the evidence of what they do.

cells.name: A network
cells.includes: Conductors of conductors across a division or network, with policies and observability
cells.format: A customer engagement. We come in, spend time with you, map the work and deliver a whole set of things.
cells.sells_acc: A custom network of cells and conductors across a division.
cells.sells_rm: Policies and observability across all the agents you run, from one to hundreds.
